objective_value: <int> Total service cost summed over all nodes assigned to their nearest open median.
opened_facilities: <list[int], length p> Indices of the nodes selected as median facility sites.
assignments: <list[dict], length n> Assignment of each node to its serving median, with fields 'customer' (node index), 'facility' (median index), and 'cost' (service cost from the node to its assigned median).
